'''Interstellar Commandos, Incorporated''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] employment company that was active during the [[Galactic War]]. It represented mercenaries and other skilled combat specialists and arranged for their employment by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and other organizations.
